newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Australian Kitary Oil signs deal with Albania.
newsitem.headline: Australian Kitary Oil signs deal with Albania.

text.p: Albania's state-owned Albpetrol on Friday signed a $22 million deal with Australia's Kitary Oil to raise production at two existing onshore oil and gas fields, Albanian television said.
Albpetrol executive director Afrim Jupi said Kitary Oil would invest $22 million in the two-stage project to redevelop two fields, Cakran-Mollaj and Ballsh-Hekal, 140 km south of Tirana.

"During the first study and experimental stage which will last 14 months, Kitary Oil will invest $6 million, while $16 million is to be spent in the second stage, the most important for increasing production," Jupi said.

"For the first time in Albania the method of bacteria injecting will be introduced, something which creates better conditions to increase oil production," Antonio Viera, a Kitary Oil official, was quoted as saying by Albanian television.
The television said it was the 12th such agreement Albania has signed in the last four years.
